digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate / lint and typecheck automation
propositions: Approved maintainability ratchets (C901 complexity, Mypy settings, Ruff ASYNC/DTZ/RUF) cannot be enforced without first resolving existing diagnostics that would fail the gates.
Four independent pyproject.toml edits must execute in a strict sequence (d9f5 → 28cd → 125d) with shared test ownership to avoid merge conflicts and ensure correct ratchet state.

All newly enforced gates must exit 0 against the current origin/main tip before the corresponding gate lands, and all pre-existing diagnostics in enforced families must be resolved or captured in baselines.
Child stories must be independently reviewed in Gerrit, merged to a feature branch, then atomically merged back to main with verified Gerrit labels and no unresolved comments.
Integration verification requires all four quality commands (lint, typecheck, config-check, pytest integration tier) to exit 0 on the completed feature worktree before closure.
